source_evidence: Exact head and remote branch both resolve to f299b09f8b307787b11e57eb5db1fb324186cd63; the PR contains the original partial-reconciliation change plus the follow-up validation fix.

controller.py reconciles only a new, ambiguous FLE transfer with a bound player, exact plan step and receipt, matching live machine unit, matching role/item/direction, and a receipt quantity strictly between zero and the requested quantity. It finishes the attempt, fails the plan, and replans without dispatching the transfer again.

telemetry.py now admits partial_transfer_reconciled only as a finished factory_insert or factory_extract outcome; it retains all normal identity, tick, timestamp, and latency validation. This makes the persisted reconciliation checkpoint resumable without broadening allowed outcomes for unrelated actions.

tests/test_attempts.py reloads the checkpoint written after the exact partial-receipt reconciliation and verifies its pending plan and attempt are cleared while the recorded outcome remains valid. It also fails closed for mock world, non-ambiguous dispatch, changed machine identity, and mismatched receipt.

factory.lua retains the native reachability guard, resolves a concrete destination inventory, verifies get_insertable_count(item) covers the full requested quantity before source removal, and retains the receipt/replay guard. Its capacity test verifies no source mutation and no receipt when capacity is short.

No PR diff introduces teleportation, accelerated movement or mining, remote interaction, inventory grants, speed changes, action replay, or manual pending/checkpoint mutation. Offline validation passed: focused tests 203 passed; full suite 1462 passed, 4 skipped.
